sources.name: Reviewed local full-text import
sources.rights_notes: Local import does not establish rights. Every candidate still needs edition-level evidence.

sources.name: Multilingual Wikisource
sources.rights_notes: Check the work and translation copyright template. Wikisource accepts public-domain or compatible free-licensed texts, but the exact page-level statement remains authoritative.

sources.name: Project Gutenberg
sources.rights_notes: Configure and review an official mirror before enabling direct downloads; never crawl human pages. Project Gutenberg copyright determinations are U.S.-specific and the embedded ebook notice must be checked.

sources.name: Perseus Digital Library GitHub corpora
sources.rights_notes: Rights vary by repository, edition, and translation. Do not inherit a corpus-level licence without checking the selected file and repository metadata.
